concepts.label: Full Text Index Alias creation - Web Console UI action
concepts.note: No prior registry term for FTS index aliases; alias points to one or more indexes for cross-bucket/cross-scope search.

notable_absence.finding: No privilege documented for creating a full text index alias, despite it being an administrative action that changes what data is exposed under an alias name - same gap as other fts/ index-management pages in this batch (clone-index, edit-index).

competency_questions_addressed: How do you create a full text index alias?
What privileges are required to create an index alias?
